title: Google expands AI Search ads globally as core ad growth slows
slides: Can Google's AI ads win back slowing growth?
AI Search ads now roll out worldwide
But users may scroll past sponsored answers
Advertisers must rethink keyword-heavy campaigns now
Test one AI ad format before your competitors do
thread_text:
1. Google's AI ad gamble

AI-powered Search ads just went global, betting growth can come from sponsored answers inside AI Overviews.

2. The scroll problem

Early data shows users often skip sponsored answers entirely, treating them like traditional banner blindness.

3. Keyword era ending

Google's AI matches intent, not strings, so campaigns built on exact-match lists may waste budget on the wrong queries.

4. Who adapts first wins

Advertisers testing AI formats now get cheaper learning cycles before competitors crowd the auction.

5. Test one format today

Run a small AI ad test in your account this week. Did it beat your keyword campaigns? Tell me your result.

Sponsored answers inside AI Overviews now show up for users worldwide, not just in test markets.

Google is betting on AI Search ads as its core ad business slows. 💰

Early data suggests people often scroll straight past those sponsored answers, like banner blindness.
